title: Instrument meal plan file and mutation services
description: Add structured debug logs to meal-plan file IO and the add/create mutation services, mirroring the shopping-list file patterns and including recipe/plan/serving context for service entry and exit.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanFiles.discover(in:)`, `readText`, `writeText`, and `plansURL(in:)` log the same boundary information pattern required for shopping lists.
`AddToMealPlanService.addToBlock`, `addNewBlock`, and `createNewPlan` log entry context including recipe URL, plan URL, servings, and scale factor where applicable.
The meal-plan service exits log success or error outcomes without introducing behavior changes.
